summary: Carded from Fabio's live incident: the no-GPU download Pod OOM-killed itself repeatedly while installing MiniMax H3 Reference, with no generation involved. Split from MPI-539 - different root (the Pod's own HF download transport, not app-side engine identity) and a different repo.
Filed under the MPI-542 umbrella (1.4.0 field fixes) at Fabio's request. Root, fix and evidence stay on this card; the umbrella tracks whether the release's field reports are actually answered.

Rewritten: the hf_xet memory hypothesis is DISPROVEN and the card now says so at the top. Fabio re-ran the same install on the same 3.725 GiB box at up to 735 MB/s - above the 652 that supposedly caused the OOM - and RunPod Telemetry read 3% memory throughout. The download transport is exonerated; so is app-side staging, because the app log shows MPI-539's abandon path firing by name in that session. Dropped to low priority and blocked: the container log that would name the real consumer was never captured and the Pod is gone. Reopen criteria recorded instead of a speculative fix.
